channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Mater Dei boys soccer wins first CIF regional title by beating Del Norte
item.description: The Monarchs, who scored the game's only goal in the ninth minute, will move on to play in the first CIF State championship game in Sacramento.

item.title: Galaxy fade late in loss to Rapids
item.description: João Klauss scores in the 56th minute, but the Galaxy finish with 10 men and concede three goals after halftime in a 4-1 loss.

item.title: Crean Lutheran’s big lead disappears as Damien rallies to win regional semifinal
item.description: Crean Lutheran leads by by 15 points early in the third quarter, but Damien dominates from there and advances to the CIF Southern California Regional Division I final.

item.title: David Martínez lifts LAFC past Dallas
item.description: Martínez scores the game’s lone goal, and Hugo Lloris helps LAFC open the season with a third straight shutout victory.

item.title: Sierra Canyon boys advance to regional final with win over Santa Margarita
item.description: Sierra Canyon will play Harvard-Westlake in the Open final of the CIF SoCal playoffs on Tuesday, with a chance to move on to the state championship game.

item.title: St. John Bosco basketball beats Mater Dei in OT of regional semifinals
item.description: Christian Collins and the St. John Bosco basketball team rallied past rival Mater Dei in the regional semifinals of the CIF state playoffs.

item.title: Sierra Canyon girls dealt stunning loss by Sage Hill in CIF regional semifinals
item.description: Sage Hill's Amalia Holguin leads her team to a surprising victory over top-seeded Sierra Canyon in the girls basketball Open Division regional semifinals.

item.title: El Dorado girls basketball holds off Canyon in CIF SoCal Regional semifinals
item.description: Girls basketball roundup: Highlights from wins by El Dorado, Laguna Hills and Godinez in the semifinal games Saturday.

item.title: Mater Dei girls basketball loses in CIF regional semifinals to Centennial
item.description: Centennial uses its size advantage to beat Mater Dei in CIF SoCal Division I and moves on to face Rancho Christian for the regional title.

item.title: Brackets set for Big West men’s and women’s basketball tournaments
item.description: UC Irvine and Hawaii are the top two seeds on the men’s side, and UCI and UC San Diego occupy the top two seeds for the women’s tournament. Both events are Wednesday-Saturday in Henderson, Nevada.
